chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurarah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Riba (usury/interest) occurs only in what is measured by volume or weighed.
ai.seo_question: What types of goods are subject to riba according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delineates the scope of riba al-fadl by restricting it to commodities measured by volume or weight, a key distinction in Shia fiqh that excludes items sold by count. This principle aligns with the Hanafi and Shafi'i schools but is articulated here with specific emphasis on the physical attributes of the goods, reinforcing the legal precision found in the Tahdhib al-Ahkam. It serves as a foundational text for determining which goods are subject to the rule of equality in exchange to avoid usury.
